caption: The SOX/SPY relative strength ratio (vermillion, left axis) — SOX divided by SPY — against the SPY price (blue, right axis), 1994–2026. Because SOX and SPY are both equity indices that co-move about 71% day-to-day, the analysis trades the RATIO, which strips out the shared market beta and isolates any genuine semiconductor leadership. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Hero shows the relative-strength ratio that the winner actually uses, not raw SOX — the co-movement-vs-edge point.
